quest.title: Afterword
quest.description:
"The Hero from another world, supported by their companions, shall restore peace to this world..."

Thus would epics of later generations speak of this time:
Thus was the fell dragon saved, thus was peace restored to Simulanka.
The people then lived happily ever after with the cute little dragon named "Durin."
Annoyed comment in the margins: Hey, you're not even bothering to rhyme anymore!
quest.rewards_formatted: Primogem x20, Mora x20000, Hero's Wit x2, Mystic Enhancement Ore x4

dialogues.speaker: Citrus
dialogues.text: Here's your two Magic Tonics!

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: Why, thank you, young lady. And might I add that you're looking quite lovely today. ...Jean, come on, take a seat and let's have a drink. I ordered one for you as well.

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: *sigh* But is this really appropriate? I mean...

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: Still worried about Klee? Relax, Albedo's with her. She'll be fine.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Kaeya and Master Jean! What are you two doing here?

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: #Oho, look who it is! {NICKNAME} and Paimon. You must be the "pleasant surprise" that Miss Alice told us about.

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: Greetings to you both. This is one place I didn't expect to run into you two.

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: The locals here have been talking non-stop about some brave heroes who saved the world... Let me guess, you two have been up to your old tricks?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Not just us, we only played a small part! You could say we were two members of the Hero's adventure team.

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: Still sounds mighty impressive to me! As ever, our Honorary Knight is making us proud wherever they roam.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Did I hear you talking about Alice and Klee?

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: That's right. We received a letter of invitation from Miss Alice, proposing that we take Klee for a vacation in fairyland when work dies down.

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: I wasn't sure what she meant by "fairyland" at first, but if my eyes are not deceiving me, she was being quite literal.

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: Klee ran off excitedly as soon as we arrived. I'm a little worried about her, but Albedo insisted he would look after her while we do our own thing.

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: We could hardly say no to such a considerate offer. So I took it upon myself to bring Jean to the nearest tavern we could find.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Any excuse to go for a drink, huh...

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: Haha, well, we are on vacation. It's only fair that we get to indulge ourselves a little.

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: ...You're right. I should make an effort to relax and unwind. It's what Miss Alice would want, after all.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: ...Oh! Wait... Kaeya, what exactly did you order from the bar?

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: The House Special, of course. Best way to get a taste of the local culture.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Pff...

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: Hmm? Why are you making that face, Paimon?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uhh... n—nothing... Paimon's just perpetually amused by your lifestyle, that's all. Go on, drink up.

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: Hmm...? Something tells me I need to tread carefully here... Let's see, it's got a lovely color, but how about the taste? ... *cough* *splutter*

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hehehehe...

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: ...I think maybe I'll pass. But it's such a shame to waste it...

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: Alright, Paimon. Well played.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Well... Paimon got burned too, if that's any consolation. It's nothing personal!

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: Oh, by the way, we weren't the only ones who got invited here. I saw Collei earlier. She didn't see me though — she was making a beeline for that big tree.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: The Kingdom of Breezes and Bells, you mean? Oh, this is turning into a huge reunion! Maybe we should go say hi to her?

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: Alright. Well, give her my regards.

response.speaker: Jean
response.text: Thank you. Enjoy your time here too.

talks.objective: Return to the Forest of Blessings and search for Mini Durin
Return to the Kingdom of Breezes and Bells and look for Collei

dialogues.speaker: Collei
dialogues.text: The structure of the tree houses here is nothing short of amazing! I have to write it down, so I can tell Master Tighnari all about it later...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey, Collei!

dialogues.speaker: Collei
dialogues.text: #Agh!! You scared me... {NICKNAME} and Paimon? You got invited here, too?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yep! ...Well, they sorta skipped the invitation part, but... Anyway, whatcha doing out here? Something caught your eye?

dialogues.speaker: Collei
dialogues.text: Oh, yeah, I'm trying to observe and summarize the structures of the trees here, and also the animals that live here — well, the residents, I guess? I still can't get over the fact that they're all someone's origami handiwork!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Once a forest ranger, always a forest ranger, huh? Not sure you'll be able to apply much of what you learn here back home, though, with this being a magical world and everything...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: ...Huh? Over there, by the giant footprint, have those houses always been there?

dialogues.speaker: Collei
dialogues.text: Oh, those? The local flying squirrels told me that they were built by a small dragon and some guy wearing a hat.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh! That must have been Mini Durin and Hat Guy! Any idea where they went?

dialogues.speaker: Collei
dialogues.text: Supposedly, after building the houses, they went to somewhere called, uh... Constellation Metropole? Did I say that right?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yep, you got it! Oh, also... When the locals mentioned the dragon, did they seem at all, uh... Did they say how they felt about him at all?

dialogues.speaker: Collei
dialogues.text: Hmm... Now that you mention it, the atmosphere changed a little when they talked about him...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh no...

dialogues.speaker: Collei
dialogues.text: They mentioned some stuff along the lines of "past misunderstandings" and "welcoming new members"...

dialogues.speaker: Collei
dialogues.text: I only just got here, so I know very little about what has happened in the past. They seemed genuinely grateful for the houses, though, and said they were going to plan a welcome party.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, thank goodness, phew... Sounds like the Forest has begun to accept him. It's a step in the right direction!

dialogues.speaker: Collei
dialogues.text: Are you looking for that small dragon?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yeah, he's a new friend we made after we arrived here.

dialogues.speaker: Collei
dialogues.text: No way! Really? I'm getting more and more interested in your story!

dialogues.speaker: Collei
dialogues.text: Ugh... No, no, no, I've got to save it for next time. For now, I've got to make the most out of my time in this wonderful world!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hehe, there's no rush! Just take it slow and enjoy yourself — like Kaeya. Oh, he sends his regards by the way.

dialogues.speaker: Collei
dialogues.text: Oh, Mr. Kaeya is here too? Then... I've got to go say hi to him!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Well, right now he's at the tavern, and he probably won't be leaving until he's drunk... Hmm, not that he'll ever reach that point since his alcohol tolerance is so high... Basically, it's Kaeya — you know where to find him!

dialogues.speaker: Collei
dialogues.text: Haha, you make a good point, Paimon. Then I'll focus on exploring for now, and go catch up with him later!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Shall we go pay a visit to the Metropole, {NICKNAME}? Maybe Mini Durin and Hat Guy are still there.

dialogues.speaker: Collei
dialogues.text: Oh right, by the way, something pretty interesting has been happening in Sumeru recently. Master Tighnari has been working really hard on it, so if you have time, definitely go check it out!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Sounds good! We'll find some time in our schedule.

response.speaker: Collei
response.text: Of course! See you later!

talks.objective: Go to the Astral Garden at the highest point in Constellation Metropole

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: What!? Are my eyes deceiving me?

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: There is no way... I can't believe it...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey, Mona! We heard you muttering from a long way away! What's up?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Is your scryglass acting up again?

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: Oh, it's you, the saviors of this world. My scryglass is fine. But I'm not sure I can say the same about my eyes...

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: Look. Look at this statue.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: ...What, is it broken or something? Looks fine to Paimon... That's your master, right? AKA, the "Goddess of Prophecy"?

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: I refuse to believe it! There's no way that old hag looks like anything like this.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Maybe she did when she was younger.

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: When she was younger? Oh, actually... Now that you mention it, this does remind me of the fashionista phase she wrote about in her diary...

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: ...She can't hear me, can she? I swear, I just got chills down my spine...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Either way, it's probably a little rude to talk about her right under her statue.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: But how did you know it's a statue of her if you never saw her as a young woman?

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: I did a quick scry when I came into this world, and when I saw the stars' reflections, I was at a loss for words... It looks like fate in Simulanka is directly based on Teyvat.

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: A projection of real-world fate, to form an image of reality...

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: Or in layman's terms... basically, the creator made this world inside a mirror, or a lake, and this world is the reflection.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Still sounds pretty impressive.

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: The more I scried, the more familiar everything looked... It's her work, there's no doubt about it. Even so, everything's far more complex than I'd imagined. Trying to decipher it all is giving me quite a headache.

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: I also asked the locals about her. They call her: "She who has dominion over the stars and the course of fate itself"... Not even a pretense of humility. Clearly, she let the role of creator-goddess get to her head...

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: Not that I'm surprised in the least, of course. It certainly matches the tone of her diary... Ahem, anyway! We should change the topic.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh! So Mona, have you seen a small dragon around by any chance? He's about the same size as Paimon, but with tiny little wings.

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: Ah, you mean the one that caused all that trouble? I haven't seen him for myself, but I heard that he came to the Metropole not long ago to formally apologize for his actions. Apparently, he brought a huge stash of toytanium and plant oil to make amends.

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: Most people accepted his apology, although there are some who said that they'll reserve judgment until they've seen how he acts in the future.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ooh, okay... Do you know where we can find him?

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: One moment...

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: Ah, it looks like he's at the Broken Sea. There's a big group of people with him, too.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Cool! Wanna come with us? We can introduce you.

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: Hmm, I think I'll sit this one out. This might be the closest I ever get to meeting the Old Hag in her youth, so I think I'll spend some time seeing what else I can glean from her grand design. You guys have fun.

response.speaker: Mona
response.text: What do you mean, "be careful"? Now you're making me nervous!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: We'll be off now. See you later, Mona!

response.speaker: Mona
response.text: Anytime.

talks.objective: Go to the Broken Sea to look for Mini Durin

dialogues.speaker: Fischl
dialogues.text: Ozvaldo Hrafnavins... Dost thou see what I am seeing? Tell me that my all-perceiving Auge der Verurteilung deceiveth me not!

dialogues.speaker: Oz
dialogues.text: Your eyes see true, Mein Fräulein.

dialogues.speaker: Fischl
dialogues.text: Very well. Then, as sovereign ruler of the Immernachtreich, I extend to you both my greetings, O Night Dragon from the Land of the Thousand Stars, and his hat-wearing servant.

dialogues.speaker: Wanderer
dialogues.text: Who did you just call a servant?

dialogues.speaker: Oz
dialogues.text: What Mein Fräulein means to say is, "Hello, it's a pleasure to meet you."

dialogues.speaker: Mini Durin
dialogues.text: Pleasure to meet you too! But Hat Guy's not my servant, he's my friend.

dialogues.speaker: Wanderer
dialogues.text: Now you're over-explaining.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hat Guy, Mini Durin! Found you at last! Whoa, and Fischl's with you, too?

dialogues.speaker: Fischl
dialogues.text: Ohoho! Greetings, Outlander blessed by the Immernachtreich! How honored you are to meet your Prinzessin beneath the stars of another sky... Clearly, a decision made by fate itself!

choices.text: I echo your sentiments, Your Highness.

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: #{F#Miss}{M#Mr.} Honorary Knight! Paimon!

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: Greetings. You both look well.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hey there Klee! Have you been having fun here?

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: Yep, loads and loads of fun! There are soooo many cute animals! And a magic train that was reeeeally long! And a huge, huge castle, and a king lives there and everything!

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: I've been taking Klee to see all the sights. It's been a very enriching experience. Alice's magic is truly outstanding.

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: Yeah, Mom's amazing! Klee wants to build a great big house now, too!

response.speaker: Mini Durin
response.text: So... Your mom and my mom... were friends?

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: Mhm! Our moms were friends, which makes you my big brother! My mom used to read your mom's stories to me all the time, they were great!

response.speaker: Mini Durin
response.text: ...Big brother?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: You're part of the family now!

response.speaker: Mini Durin
response.text: Wow... Thank you, Klee! Can I go play with Klee, Hat Guy?

response.speaker: Wanderer
response.text: Suit yourself.

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: Albedo, Albedo, can I—

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: Go on — just don't go too far away. I'll come pick you up later.

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: Yey! C'mon Mini Durin! Do you wanna come play with us too, Fischl?

response.speaker: Fischl
response.text: Hehehe! Your Prinzessin accepts your invitation. Rejoice! Though you may be concealed by fog, still you shall have the good fortune to witness the true might of the Auge der Verurteilung!

response.speaker: Oz
response.text: What Mein Fräulein means to say is, perhaps we can all play hide-and-seek together. Mein Fräulein is "it."

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: Hooray! I love hide-and-seek!

response.speaker: Mini Durin
response.text: Me too!

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: To return to our previous discussion, Mr. Hat Guy, you were telling me about a prophecy?

response.speaker: Wanderer
response.text: I heard B talking to M. What she said was...

response.speaker: "B"
response.text: Since you're so persistent, let me tell you a secret...

response.speaker: "B"
response.text: R's child... will one day rise from the dead.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh? Is she saying that... Dragonspine-Durin will come back to life!?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: I'm shocked...

response.speaker: Wanderer
response.text: I only heard it in a memory. So don't hold me to it.

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: Understood. My recent observations at Dragonspine lend credence to this prophecy as well.

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: Durin's heart has slowly but surely been growing in vitality. The process is extremely slow, but the trend is clear...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Aah... What should we do?

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: To start with, plan for every potential scenario. Including, of course, the worst-case scenario...

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: I am well aware of Durin's past, and I sincerely hope that things never escalate to that point. Still, we need to be prepared for every possibility.

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: If the prophecy is true, and Durin's heart will one day beat again... I'd like to hope that whatever rises from the dead is no "evil dragon."

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: If you understand what I mean.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Kind of...? But not really.

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: And so... When the time comes, Mr. Hat Guy, will you and Simulanka's Durin be willing to lend us a hand in our hour of need?

response.speaker: Wanderer
response.text: Huh? What's this got to do with me?

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: You saved the Durin of this world. I don't see that as a mere coincidence.

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: If there is any meaning to be read into the actions of the three Goddesses beyond fairytale whimsy alone, I can only boldly speculate that...

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: ...The fate of this reflected world may have a reciprocal effect upon our own world.

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: If Durin of Dragonspine will soon come back to life, we will need Mini Durin's help... as well as yours, given that your fates are now intertwined.

response.speaker: Wanderer
response.text: Well, that's a nuisance.

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: To be sure. It certainly won't be easy.

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: Albedo, Albedo! There's a flying paper ship over there! Can we go see it together, pleeease?

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: Sure. Two seconds, I'll be right with you.

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: Please give my suggestion some thought, Mr. Hat Guy.

response.speaker: Mini Durin
response.text: Hat Guy, I'm back! ...Hmm? What were you guys talking about?

response.speaker: Wanderer
response.text: Nothing.

response.speaker: Mini Durin
response.text: Huh? Okay then. Let's go join the others. Everyone's going to check out the new origami ship!

response.speaker: Wanderer
response.text: ...Alright. I'll be right there.

response.speaker: Wanderer
response.text: Why would I be? Do I strike you as someone who cares about other people's issues?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: (Now that he's saved Simulanka's Durin, maybe he'll be sympathetic to the Durin of our world...?)

response.speaker: Wanderer
response.text: Quit trying to guess what I'm thinking. I'm leaving.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: (Hmm, Albedo was right. He needs time to think about it for himself.)

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: Aww! What a lovely little boat!

response.speaker: Mini Durin
response.text: The Forest Fairy helped us make it!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon just realized, there's a lot fewer people around the Broken Sea now. Guess most of them have made their way back to the Metropole.

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: Does this boat have a name? I can't see one anywhere!

response.speaker: Mini Durin
response.text: Huh...? A name?

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: Mhm! Every boat has a name! At least, all the ones I've seen before.

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: They're usually symbolic names that represent something aspirational.

response.speaker: Wanderer
response.text: Let's go with "The Durin."

response.speaker: Mini Durin
response.text: Huh? You want to name it after me?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh! You mean, to wish Mini Durin a safe voyage as he sails into a new chapter of his life beyond this world?

response.speaker: Fischl
response.text: Your Prinzessin approves. Let this vessel bear the name of the most esteemed dragon of the night.

response.speaker: Mini Durin
response.text: "The Durin"... Hehe, let's call it that, then! Thank you, Hat Guy!

response.speaker: Mini Durin
response.text: Also... Can I ask you a favor?

response.speaker: Wanderer
response.text: ...Go on.

response.speaker: Mini Durin
response.text: Remember how Mom's friend said I should be able to leave this world? Well... I want to pay a visit to your world. Just a quick trip! Can we?

response.speaker: Wanderer
response.text: ...Huh?

response.speaker: Mini Durin
response.text: ...I—Is that a no?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon thinks that's a great idea. If the people of Simulanka are allowed to go to Teyvat, then what's the problem with taking Mini Durin there for a visit?

response.speaker: Wanderer
response.text: ...I'm assuming I'll have to be your bodyguard while we're there?

response.speaker: Mini Durin
response.text: I... I can protect myself! And I'll do what you say, I won't fly off on my own, I promise! Please, can I go?

response.speaker: Wanderer
response.text: ...It'll be up to you to stick close. If you disappear on me, don't expect me to come looking.

response.speaker: Mini Durin
response.text: Got it! I'll stick close!

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: Why don't you take The Durin? Now you've given it a name, it'll be a maiden voyage for the boat and a brand-new journey for you.

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: Are you leaving, Mini Durin? Okay... Well, make sure you come visit me in Mondstadt so we can play together again! Klee will draw you a map to show you the way.

response.speaker: Fischl
response.text: Though our time together has been as fleeting as a ray of light in the depths of the long night, the Immernachtreich will welcome you with the grandest of music ceremonies on the occasion of our next reunion. As surely as the stars in the sky watch over us, we shall meet again.

response.speaker: Oz
response.text: What Mein Fräulein means is that you're always welcome to visit her at home as well.

response.speaker: Mini Durin
response.text: Cool! Ah, I have so many new friends now... I'm so happy!

response.speaker: Wanderer
response.text: Are you done yet? If you want to leave, then get over here.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Take care.

response.speaker: Mini Durin
response.text: Thank you, everyone! Thank you so much! The blessings you gave me are more precious than any treasure, and more beautiful than any fairytale!

response.speaker: Mini Durin
response.text: Next time, it will be my turn to make your wishes come true!

choices.text: It's great to see you too.

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: So the "Magic Tonic" here is just writing ink... What a weird and wonderful world.

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: Ah, Miss Citrus — do you happen to serve any beverages here that don't contain Magic Tonic?

dialogues.speaker: Citrus
dialogues.text: Of course we do. What flavor would you like?

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: Hmm, Sunsettia? Jean, you want in?

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: ...Sure, I'll have the same please.

dialogues.speaker: Citrus
dialogues.text: Sounds good! Two sunsettia drinks, coming right up!

dialogues.speaker: Collei
dialogues.text: The origami squirrels rely on wind currents to lift their agile bodies and easily move between the trees... This has created a truly unique ecosystem.

dialogues.speaker: Collei
dialogues.text: Oh no... I'm running out of pages on my notebook...

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: (Creating a whole world's starscape is no easy task...)

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: (Old Hag... I guess you do deserve the title of Trismegistus after all.)

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It's been a while since our last adventure! Paimon wonders how Mini Durin is getting along in Simulanka.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Let's go to the Forest of Blessings and take a look!
